items.title: Jackson Hole Symposium kicks off, Marvell & dollar stores report earnings: What to Watch
items.summary: Yahoo Finance's Josh Lipton takes a closer look at the top stories for investors to watch on Thursday, Aug. 26, including quarterly earnings results from Marvell (MRVL), Dollar General (DG), and Dollar Tree (DLTR). Meanwhile, the 2026 Jackson Hole Economic Policy Symposium kicks off, setting the stage for Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh's upcoming Friday remarks.

items.title: Dollar General (DG) Stock Trades Up, Here Is Why
items.summary: Shares of discount retailer Dollar General (NYSE:DG) jumped 5.3% in the afternoon session after the company reported second-quarter financial results that beat Wall Street expectations and raised its full-year outlook. According to a company press release, Dollar General reported net sales of $11.3 billion for the second quarter, representing a 5.2% increase year-over-year, which topped analyst estimates of $11.19 billion.
